config LC709203F
	bool "ON Semiconductor LC709203F Fuel Gauge driver"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_ONNN_LC709203F_ENABLED
	select I2C
	select CRC
	help
	  Enable driver for the ON Semiconductor LC709203F fuel gauge.
